components.name: Button
components.description: Default outlined button, sentence case; tints amber on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; background:transparent; color:var(--color-txt); border:1px solid var(--color-edge); border-radius:0; padding:4px 12px; font-family:Saira, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:500; transition:background-color .15s, border-color .15s; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color:rgb(240 138 44 / .7); background:rgb(240 138 44 / .1); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:1px solid var(--color-or); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one solid amber action on a screen (Start timer).

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action; coral is reserved for this and for failures.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background:transparent; color:var(--color-bad); border:1px solid rgb(224 115 90 / .6); border-radius:0; padding:4px 12px; font-family:Saira, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:500; transition:background-color .15s, border-color .15s; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { border-color:var(--color-bad); background:rgb(224 115 90 / .1); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:1px solid var(--color-or); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Input

components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; width:208px; background:var(--color-bg); border-right:1px solid var(--color-frame); padding:12px 0; } .ds-nav-item { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; height:34px; padding:0 22px; font-family:'Saira Condensed', Saira, sans-serif; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.07em; font-size:15px; font-weight:600; color:var(--color-mute); cursor:pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color:var(--color-txt); } .ds-nav-item.is-active { background:var(--color-or); color:#1a0d02; } .ds-nav-count { font-family:Saira, sans-serif; text-transform:none; font-size:13px; font-weight:500; opacity:.8; } .ds-nav-sub { display:flex; align-items:center; height:28px; padding-left:36px; font-family:'Saira Condensed', Saira, sans-serif; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.07em; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:500; color:var(--color-dim); cursor:pointer; } .ds-nav-sub:hover { color:var(--color-txt); } .ds-nav-sub.is-active { color:var(--color-or); }

components.css: .ds-panel { background:var(--color-frame); padding:1px; width:360px; clip-path: polygon(6px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 6px), calc(100% - 6px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 6px); } .ds-panel-face { background:var(--color-panel); padding:16px 20px; color:var(--color-txt); font-family:Saira, sans-serif; font-size:15px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; clip-path: polygon(6px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 6px), calc(100% - 6px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 6px); } .ds-panel-head { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:baseline; margin-bottom:8px; } .ds-panel-head h2 { margin:0; font-family:'Saira Condensed', Saira, sans-serif; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.07em; font-size:15px; font-weight:600; } .ds-panel-head span { font-size:13px; color:var(--color-mute); } .ds-meter-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 60px 56px; gap:12px; align-items:center; padding:7px 0; } .ds-meter-row > span:last-child { text-align:right; font-size:14px; } .ds-meter-row.is-quiet { color:var(--color-mute); } .ds-meter { position:relative; display:block; height:3px; background:var(--color-line); } .ds-meter > span { position:absolute; inset:0 auto 0 0; background:rgb(240 138 44 / .85); }

narrative.overview:
A star atlas worn in the menu language of Elite: Dangerous, with the volume turned down. The waking day is a route you travel along; goals are stars you steer by. Space-black ground, panels held in thin orange-brown frames with clipped corners, condensed capitals for the instrument labels and plain sentence-case Saira for everything a person reads. It is a cockpit that never raises its voice: no alarms, nothing pulsing for attention, no fake telemetry, nothing red for falling behind. Like Elite's own panels it has depth: translucent glass over what lies behind, soft shadows under what floats, and a glow on the one thing that is selected or now.

Density is operational, not airy: a fixed 208px left rail, a 62px page head, then framed panels in a 22px-gutter grid. One amber-orange carries every meaning of "now, running, tracked, selected"; one cyan carries "planned" and "the agent". Everything else is warm grey on blue-black. The two signature drawings, the day arc on Today and the star map on Graph, are the only places with the engraved grid and the only places with reticles.

It refuses the stretched single phone column and the grey-card planner. Dark only; there is no light theme and none is to be built.
keyCharacteristics: Space black with a cool undertone, panels one step lighter, wells one step darker.
Orange-brown 1px frames with 6px chamfers on outer panels; everything else square.
Amber-orange means now / running / tracked / selected; cyan means calendar and agent.
Saira Condensed caps for titles, nav, section heads, field labels, big readouts; Saira sentence case for the rest, buttons included.
Four-point stars and corner-bracket reticles as the only ornament.
Under target is dim, never red.

rules.name: The Colour Has Jobs Rule
rules.body: Amber is now, running, tracked and selected. Cyan is planned and agent. Coral is broken. No colour is used for decoration or for categories.

rules.name: The Two Solid Fills Rule
rules.body: As a filled control, solid amber appears at most twice per screen: the active nav item and the one primary action. (Data marks, such as tracked time on the arc and the phone bar, are drawn in amber and do not count.) Every other selection is a quiet amber tint (8% alpha) with a 1px amber inset edge (55% alpha).

rules.name: The Never Red Rule
rules.body: Under target, behind, overdue and unstarted are shown dim (`mute` / `dim`), never coral. Coral is reserved for machinery that has failed.

rules.name: The Condensed Caps Are Instruments Rule
rules.body: Condensed caps are for page titles, nav, section heads, field labels and big readouts. Nothing else. Buttons, sentences, task and goal names in lists stay sentence case Saira. The one exception is goal names on the star map, which are labelled like stars.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numerals are always tabular; time and hours never jitter.

rules.name: The Quiet-Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Emphasis comes from colour and fill first. Glow marks only the one selected, focused or current thing; nothing pulses, shimmers or flashes to get attention. Blur is allowed as a backdrop behind what opens over other content, and a soft black shadow under what floats.

rules.name: The Engraved-Grid Rule
rules.body: The faint 60px engraved grid (white at 2.5-3% alpha) sits behind the day arc and the star map only. Not behind panels, pages or lists.

dos: Do frame outer panels with the 1px `frame` shell and the 6px two-corner chamfer, and keep everything inside them square.
Do reserve solid amber for the active nav item and the one primary action on a screen; mark every other selection with the 8% amber tint and 1px 55% amber inset edge.
Do use cyan only for calendar (planned) time and for the agent.
Do set page titles, nav, section heads, field labels and big readouts in Saira Condensed caps (0.07-0.08em tracking), and everything else, buttons included, in sentence-case Saira.
Do show under-target and unstarted as dim text and less amber, never as an alert.
Do use the four-point star and the corner-bracket reticle as the world's only glyphs for goals, flags, now and selection.
donts: Don't use scanlines, pulsing, coloured shadows, or glow as decoration or on more than the one or two highlighted things on a screen; the selected star's reticle is the strongest emphasis the world has.
Don't put fake HUD numbers, decorative telemetry or invented coordinates on screen; every figure is real data.
Don't use coral for overdue, behind, or under target; coral means a machine has failed.
Don't round corners on buttons, inputs, chips or panels; the only round shapes are status dots and map bodies.
Don't spread the engraved grid beyond the day arc and the star map.
Don't stretch a single phone-width column across the desktop or fall back to grey rounded cards.
